name.zh: 珠雫回想兄长并挑战雷切
name.en: Shizuku Remembers Ikki and Enters the Raikiri Match

periods.summary: Shizuku remembers her childhood, when adults indulged her Blazer talent but Ikki alone slapped her and told her not to bully the weak. She resolves that her love for Ikki and her wish to stand beside him must be proven by challenging Toka Todo.
periods.cause: Shizuku wants strength enough to accompany Ikki to the Seven Stars summit.
periods.process: The announcer introduces Shizuku as Lorelei and Toka as Raikiri; Shizuku senses Toka's superior level but becomes more excited to test herself.
periods.outcome: The battle begins with Shizuku fully focused on surpassing her limits.
periods.significance: Establishes Shizuku's origin of devotion to Ikki and the emotional stakes of her match.
